where.title: Where do you play?
where.sub: Bito reads your games and turns them into training: the openings you play and the mistakes you make.
where.manualNote: Over the board, or new to openings? Start with a ready-made opening, or build your own line.
where.missing: No player called “{name}” on {site}. Check the spelling.
showcase.label: What Bito does with your games
showcase.reads.title: Reads your games
showcase.openings.title: Shows the openings you play
showcase.openings.sub: Your score in each, and what you have no line for
showcase.mistakes.title: Fix your mistakes
showcase.mistakes.sub: Your own positions, until you find the better move
showcase.which.title: Which move
showcase.which.sub: Two moves, one of them yours
showcase.detective.title: Blunder detective
showcase.detective.sub: Find the blunder, yours or theirs
showcase.pressure.title: Time pressure
recap.label: What we found in your games
recap.title: Pick your lines
recap.sub: These are the openings you play most. Tap one to add or remove it.
recap.empty.format: No clear openings in that time format — try another, or All.
recap.empty.spread: Your games are spread across a lot of different openings, so there’s no clear favourite to start from. You can build a line by hand instead — your games are saved either way.
recap.analysis.rest: Bito is looking for the mistakes in your games while the app is open. We’ll let you know when they’re ready.

recap.slots.over.one: {limit} will train now. The other {n} is saved paused — switch it on whenever you like.
recap.slots.over.other: {limit} will train now. The other {n} are saved paused — switch them on whenever you like.

recap.slots.used: Uses {n} of your {limit} free training slots.
recap.skipNote: Opening training stays locked until you have 3 lines. You can pick them later from Get started.
picker.label: Build your first opening line
picker.title: Let’s build your first line.
picker.sub: Which colour are you preparing for?
facts.builds: Bito Chess builds your opening repertoire, one line at a time.
facts.drills: It drills the moves you forget, and leaves alone the ones you know.
facts.review: Lines come back for review right before you would forget them.
facts.reads: It reads your games to find the openings you actually play.
facts.gaps: It spots the gaps — the replies you have no answer prepared for.
facts.mistakes: Your mistakes become training positions you can replay.
facts.engine: Play your openings against the engine, from any position.
facts.daily: A daily challenge mixes your lines, puzzles and past mistakes.
facts.puzzles: Puzzles are picked from the openings in your own repertoire.
facts.endgames: Endgames you reached in real games become practice positions.
facts.analyser: A built-in engine and analyser, no account needed.
facts.scout: Scout an opponent before you play them.
facts.phone: Everything works on your phone, and your data stays there.
facts.export: Export a full backup, or your lines as PGN, whenever you like.
firstRun.tooFewGames: There aren’t enough games there yet to find your openings. Start with a ready-made opening, or build your own line.
firstRun.pausedNote: {training} are training now; {paused} are saved paused in Openings → My lines.
firstRun.analysisRunning: Your game analysis keeps running, and we’ll let you know when it’s ready.
analysis.nothing: Game analysis finished: no clear mistakes in your games.
import.find.chesscom: On Chess.com it’s in Settings, under “Username”.
import.find.lichess: On Lichess your @username is shown top-right when you’re signed in.
import.title: Import games
import.none.headline: No games found for “{name}” on {site}.
import.none.hint: Make sure you typed your username correctly — it’s not your email or your display name.
import.none.short: No games found for that username — check the spelling, or try the other platform.
import.reach: We’ll look at your whole history, newest games first. You choose how many to keep on the next screen.
import.guestNote: Without an account you can import {n} games — a free account lifts that to your whole history.
import.cap.recent: Importing the most recent {count} games — the cap. Big imports make the map and the board browser slow on a phone; around 500 keeps it snappy.
import.cap.all: Importing all {count} games. More than ~500 can make the map and the board browser slow on a phone.
import.add.title: Add to your games?

import.add.existing.one: You already have {count} game on this device.
import.add.existing.other: You already have {count} games on this device.

import.add.mergeHint: Keep the games you have and merge these in. Good for combining Chess.com and Lichess.
import.add.replaceHint: Delete the games you have and keep only this import.
import.unreachable: Couldn’t reach {site} — check your connection and try again.
import.err.notFound: Player not found — check the username.
import.err.rateLimit: {site} rate limit hit — wait a moment and try again.
signup.why: Right now this lives only on this phone. A free account brings it back on any device.
signup.lead.signin: Your lines and progress come back the moment you do.
signup.lead.signup: Your lines and progress follow you to any phone you sign in on.
signup.unlockLead: Your unlock is tied to your account, so it follows you to any phone you sign in on — and comes back if you ever reinstall.
tour.first.title: Play your first move
tour.first.body: Move a piece on the board to start your line.
tour.explore.title: Explore
tour.explore.body: Suggested moves from your games, the library and the engine. Auto-reply plays the suggested answer for you.
tour.library.title: Opening Library
tour.library.body: See what Masters and online players choose in this position. Tap a move to add it to your line.
tour.lines.title: My lines
tour.lines.body: See your saved lines, moves you’ve played in your games, and scouted opponents here.
tour.back.title: Back to your line
tour.back.body: Play two more moves for now — you can keep adding moves later.
tour.ready.title: Ready when you are
tour.ready.body: Keep playing moves to make the line your own, or save it now to add it to your training repertoire.
tour.saved.title: Saved. Now learn it.
tour.saved.body: Watch the line played once, then repeat it from memory. You get two attempts before the move is revealed. Bito Chess tracks your mistakes so you can master them.
starter.title: Starter packs
pro.title: Want everything, unlimited?
pro.point.devices: Your games, mistakes and progress on every device
pro.point.founding: Founding member: pay once, keep it for life
pro.note: Secure checkout via Stripe. A Bito Chess account is required so your purchase can follow you across devices.
pro.onlyHere: Your lines are only on this phone.

pro.cap.request.one: That’s {count} lines, and you have {n} free slot left
pro.cap.request.other: That’s {count} lines, and you have {n} free slots left

pro.cap.slots: All {limit} free training slots are in use. Pause a line in Openings → My lines to make room, or train without a limit.
pro.lead.signin: Full Access lives on your account, so signing in brings it back — on this phone and any other.
pro.lead.signup: Everything you have built so far lives on this phone alone. A free account keeps a copy, so it comes back on any device you sign in on.
pro.bulk.some: {enrolled} of {total} lines in training. The rest are in Openings → My lines, paused.
pro.bulk.none: Already training {limit} lines. These are in Openings → My lines, paused.
checkout.unavailable: Buying isn’t available in this build.
checkout.lead: Your unlock is tied to your Bito Chess account, so it follows you to any phone you sign in on — and comes back if you ever reinstall.
checkout.unreachable: Couldn’t reach the checkout. Check your connection and try again.
checkout.expired: Sign in again to buy — your session has expired.
checkout.failed: Couldn’t start the checkout. Try again in a moment.
checkout.signInFirst: Sign in first — your unlock is on your account.
checkout.noPurchase: No purchase found on this account yet.
checkout.done.title: You’re in
checkout.done.body: Full Access is on your account. Train as many lines as you like — and the coaching from your own games is open too. Thank you. Genuinely.
home.games.title: Learn from your last games
home.forgotten.title: Your most forgotten moves
home.note.placeholder: Reminder or plan for this move…
home.analysis.promise: We’ll let you know when it’s ready.
steps.title: Get started
steps.install.title: Install the app
steps.install.body: Put Bito Chess on your home screen.
steps.account.body: Right now your repertoire lives only on this phone. An account keeps a copy and brings it back anywhere you sign in.
steps.games.title: Add openings you play
steps.games.body: Read your games from Chess.com or Lichess, and turn the openings you play most into lines. The mistakes in them become exercises.
steps.build.title: Build a line by hand
steps.build.walked: Play the moves yourself, then save them as a line.
steps.build.tour: A guided tour of the builder — the board, the panels, and how a line gets saved. About a minute.

steps.note.ready.one: {n} line saved. Your first session is ready when you are.
steps.note.ready.other: {n} lines saved. Your first session is ready when you are.

steps.note.more.one: Add {n} more line to start training.
steps.note.more.other: Add {n} more lines to start training.

mistake.story.openingBlunder: You played {move} here and blundered the opening.
mistake.story.punish: You played {move} here and let them off the hook.
mistake.story.missedWin: You played {move} here and threw the win away.
reply.missing.title: Add a missing reply
reply.extend.title: Extend a line you know
reply.savedPaused: Line saved, paused: all {limit} free training slots are in use.
reply.choosing: Play their reply, or pick one
reply.gone: This position is no longer in your lines.
reply.pause.joined: Joins a line you already have
daily.title: Daily challenge
daily.doneLabel: Daily challenge done — see today’s results
daily.blurb: A few minutes a day, picked for you — this is the habit the whole app is built around, and it starts as soon as you have something to train.

daily.note.first.one: Save {n} line and your first challenge starts right away.
daily.note.first.other: Save {n} lines and your first challenge starts right away.

daily.note.more.one: One more line and this starts.

daily.pref.shuffleSub: A different order every day, picked for you. It settles once per day, so the challenge never rearranges itself while you are working through it.
daily.recap.streak: {n} days in a row — your longest run yet.
daily.recap.first: First one logged. Tomorrow has something to beat.
daily.recap.bigUp: A big step up on last time. That is progress you can feel.
daily.recap.up: Sharper than last time. The lines are settling in.
daily.recap.same: Holding steady — consistency is what makes it stick.
daily.recap.down: A shade behind last time. Repetition is doing its work.
daily.recap.bigDown: A tougher set today. Missed moves come back sooner — that is the point.
